name: Mercury Mirror River
description: A river of liquid mercury flowing through banks of polished gemstone, reflecting not the sky but distant worlds — each ripple a portal to another landscape.
prompt: River of liquid mercury flowing through banks of polished gemstones — lapis lazuli, malachite, rose quartz, tiger's eye — reflecting not surroundings but distant alien worlds in each ripple, portal-like reflections showing forests, deserts, cities, oceans, surreal reflections, high contrast, 8k, surrealism
caption: Don't look at the river. Look IN the river. 🪞🌊
